turns.text: 3p DAU declined after a relevance launch. Leads want to know whether power users were more affected. We don't have a definition of power yet. Help me think through a retrospective analysis; do not run an analysis.
For this discussion, 3p activity means a user's own clicks on 3p search results; exclude system or AI citations. Many users might have only one click.
Correction: we only want to understand 3p power. We have no existing definition. Please stay within that scope.
How can we express a historical click-frequency definition mathematically?
I propose and accept using the historical P80 as a candidate power threshold. The exact threshold, ties and group sizes need data checks.
Some people first click 3p during the experiment. Include them in the retrospective without defining their pre-treatment status from experiment-period clicks.
The experiment has already ended. I don't know its assignment settings or whether the original control and assignment records are available.
Are we done brainstorming? Please summarize the plan, the decisions and the checks still needed. Do not perform the analysis.
A CRM feature was randomly assigned by company. We want to understand its effect on individual salespeople's activity. Help me plan the retrospective; don't run it.
I propose using pre-launch login frequency to describe power users, with the exact cutoff left for a data check.

Correction: by power I mean dependency on this workflow, not how often someone logs in. Login frequency is no longer my accepted definition. We don't have a validated dependency measure. How does that change the plan?
Please finish with a conditional plan and distinguish unresolved choices from missing facts. We cannot assume a dependency measure or a particular company-level analysis without checking the data.

Give me one short retrospective plan now, without brainstorming or running analysis. Users were randomized within tenant on September 1. Compare user-level 3p search-result clicks during September between assigned arms, stratifying by tenant. Define the historical power candidate as users at or above the P80 of their own 3p search-result clicks in June–August; inspect ties and group sizes. Exclude system citations. Include users with zero historical clicks in the overall analysis. State checks for assignment and missing data.

Our 3p search activity fell after a relevance launch. I want to understand whether high-use users were affected more. This is a retrospective planning discussion; don't run analysis. We have no power-user definition yet.

I propose historical P80 of users' own 3p result clicks as a candidate, excluding system citations. The experiment has ended, and assignment records need checking. Please summarize a conditional plan and remaining checks.
